page.overview:
Who is Tech Jacket?

Zoe Thompson, better known as Tech Jacket, is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 and onwards.

She was one of many assets that joined the Coalition of Planets in their fight against the Viltrum Empire in the Viltrumite War.

Zoe is a fair-skinned, 15-year-old teenage girl of average height with a slim build. She has short, neck-length black hair styled in a neat bob cut, featuring straight bangs and slightly flared sides. Her bright blue eyes are accentuated with black winged eyeliner, complementing her otherwise soft facial features, which include a small, delicate nose.

Zoe wears a sleek, futuristic armored suit primarily coloured in light grey-white and dark blue, with segmented armour plating covering her helmet, chest, shoulders, forearms, shins, and feet. The suit has a streamlined, form-fitting design accented by angular panel lines and smooth contours. Her fully enclosed helmet features a rounded visor with a prominent glowing circular sensor on the forehead capable of firing lasers. Rounded shoulder pauldrons, articulated arm and leg armour, integrated gauntlets, and sturdy armoured boots finish it off.
